models.name: Bonsai 2 4B

engines.hardware: MacBook Pro M5 Pro, 32 concurrent streams
engines.quant: ternary 4B (Qwen3.5 based); the batch processed 250 emails into JSON summaries, action items, calendar events and priority scores, peak memory <4GB, over 700 tok/s aggregate

models.why: The 4B ternary model runs 32 concurrent streams on an M5 Pro inside <4GB peak memory and generates over 700 tok/s aggregate while turning 250 emails into structured JSON — the high-volume, on-device shape the size is built for.
